Create one production-quality Chinese first-use onboarding GUIDE IMAGE for the existing Figo Agent workbench, using the provided screenshot as the exact underlying UI reference. Preserve the screenshot's actual interface layout, logo, three-column proportions, top toolbar, open inspector drawer, right-hand task conversation and input, and lower terminal. Use the supplied image only as a safe demonstration workspace. Do not invent new application controls or move any actual toolbar button. The screenshot is the entire edge-to-edge background. Apply a uniform translucent neutral charcoal dimming layer so the real UI remains recognizable but all onboarding labels dominate clearly. Do not turn the screenshot into a floating framed card or a device mockup. Landscape 16:10 composition, ideally 1440 by 900 or a larger proportional resolution.

Add a crisp, refined overlay in Chinese: white legible sans-serif text, large numbered teal circles 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and a few restrained curved white arrows pointing precisely at the real regions. Each feature annotation consists of a prominent number, short bold heading and one short explanatory line. Labels float directly on the dimmed screenshot without separate cards, heavy boxes, or decorative blobs. Use consistent typography and sufficient spacing, no overlaps, no clipped text. The reading order is the numbers, all five visible simultaneously. Make all five callouts clearly readable at normal desktop scale.

- Callout 1 in upper-right area with a short curved arrow to the actual sliders/settings icon at the top right (not the adjacent trace pulse icon).
